232 static void MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_reportFxn
233 (
234  DPM_Report reportType,
235  uint32_t instanceId,
236  int32_t errCode,
237  uint32_t arg0,
238  uint32_t arg1
239 )
240 {
241 
242  /* Only errors are logged on the console: */
243  if (errCode != 0)
244  {
245  /* Error: Detected log on the console and die all errors are FATAL currently. */
246  test_print ("Error: DPM Report %d received with error:%d arg0:0x%x arg1:0x%x\n",
247  reportType, errCode, arg0, arg1);
248  DebugP_assert (0);
249  }
250 
251  /* Processing further is based on the reports received: This is the control of the profile
252  * state machine: */
253  switch (reportType)
254  {
255  case DPM_Report_IOCTL:
256  {
257  /*****************************************************************
258  * DPC has been configured without an error:
259  * - This is an indication that the profile configuration commands
260  * went through without any issues.
261  *****************************************************************/
262  DebugP_logInfo("DSSApp: DPM Report IOCTL, command = %d\n", arg0);
263  break;
264  }
265  case DPM_Report_DPC_STARTED:
266  {
267  /*****************************************************************
268  * DPC has been started without an error:
269  * - notify sensor management task that DPC is started.
270  *****************************************************************/
271  DebugP_logInfo("DSSApp: DPM Report start\n");
272  break;
273  }
274  case DPM_Report_NOTIFY_DPC_RESULT:
275  {
276  /*****************************************************************
277  * DPC Results have been passed:
278  * - This implies that we have valid profile results which have
279  * been received from the profile.
280  *****************************************************************/
281 
282  break;
283  }
284  case DPM_Report_NOTIFY_DPC_RESULT_ACKED:
285  {
286  /*****************************************************************
287  * DPC Results have been acked:
288  * - This implies that MSS received the results.
289  *****************************************************************/
290 
291  break;
292  }
293  case DPM_Report_DPC_ASSERT:
294  {
295  DPM_DPCAssert* ptrAssert;
296 
297  /*****************************************************************
298  * DPC Fault has been detected:
299  * - This implies that the DPC has crashed.
300  * - The argument0 points to the DPC assertion information
301  *****************************************************************/
302  ptrAssert = (DPM_DPCAssert*)arg0;
303  test_print ("DSS Exception: %s, line %d.\n", ptrAssert->fileName,
304  ptrAssert->lineNum);
305  break;
306  }
307  case DPM_Report_DPC_STOPPED:
308  {
309  /*****************************************************************
310  * DPC has been stopped without an error:
311  * - This implies that the DPC can either be reconfigured or
312  * restarted.
313  *****************************************************************/
314  DebugP_logInfo("DSSApp: DPM Report stop\n");
315 
316  MmwDemo_sensorStopEpilog();
317  break;
318  }
319  case DPM_Report_DPC_INFO:
320  {
321  /* Currently objDetHwa does not use this feature. */
322  break;
323  }
324  default:
325  {
326  DebugP_assert (0);
327  break;
328  }
329  }
330  return;
331 }

383  void MmwDemo_updateObjectDetStats
384 (
385  DPC_ObjectDetection_Stats *currDpcStats,
386  MmwDemo_output_message_stats *outputMsgStats
387 )
388 {
389  static uint32_t prevInterFrameEndTimeStamp = 0U;
390 
391  /* Calculate interframe proc time */
392  outputMsgStats->interFrameProcessingTime =
393  (currDpcStats->interFrameEndTimeStamp - currDpcStats->interFrameStartTimeStamp)/DSP_CLOCK_MHZ; /* In micro seconds */
394 
395  outputMsgStats->interChirpProcessingMargin = currDpcStats->interChirpProcessingMargin/DSP_CLOCK_MHZ;
396 
397  /* Calculate interFrame processing Margin for previous frame, but saved to current frame */
398  outputMsgStats->interFrameProcessingMargin =
399  (currDpcStats->frameStartTimeStamp - prevInterFrameEndTimeStamp - currDpcStats->subFramePreparationCycles)/DSP_CLOCK_MHZ;
400 
401  prevInterFrameEndTimeStamp = currDpcStats->interFrameEndTimeStamp;
402 }

419  MmwDemo_HSRAM *ptrHsramBuffer,

422 )
423 {

428  /* Save result in HSRAM */

431  return -1;

436  {
437  itemPayloadLen = sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult);

442  return -1;

519  ptrCurrBuffer+= itemPayloadLen;

541  else

577 static void MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_dpmTask(void* args)
578 {
579  int32_t retVal;
580  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *result;
581  volatile uint32_t startTime;
582 
583  while (1)
584  {
585  /* Execute the DPM module: */
586  retVal = DPM_execute (gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle, &resultBuffer);
587  if (retVal < 0) {
588  test_print ("Error: DPM execution failed [Error code %d]\n", retVal);
589  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
590  }
591  else
592  {
593  if ((resultBuffer.size[0] == sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult)))
594  {
595  result = (DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *)resultBuffer.ptrBuffer[0];
596 
597  /* Get the time stamp before copy data to HSRAM */
598  startTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
599 
600  /* Update processing stats and added it to buffer 1*/
601  MmwDemo_updateObjectDetStats(result->stats,
602  &gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj.subFrameStats[result->subFrameIdx]);
603 
604  /* Cache invalidation for gHSRAM needed to avoid incoherency issues between DSS and MSS */
605  CacheP_inv(&gHSRAM,SYS_COMMON_HSRAM_SIZE,CacheP_TYPE_ALL);
606  /* Copy result data to HSRAM */
607  if ((retVal = MmwDemo_copyResultToHSRAM(&gHSRAM, result, &gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj.subFrameStats[result->subFrameIdx])) >= 0)
608  {
609  /* Update interframe margin with HSRAM copy time */
610  gHSRAM.outStats.interFrameProcessingMargin -= ((CycleCounterP_getCount32() - startTime)/DSP_CLOCK_MHZ);
611 
612  /* Update DPM buffer */
613  resultBuffer.ptrBuffer[0] = (uint8_t *)&gHSRAM.result;
614  resultBuffer.ptrBuffer[1] = (uint8_t *)&gHSRAM.outStats;
615  resultBuffer.size[1] = sizeof(MmwDemo_output_message_stats);
616 
617 
618  /* YES: Results are available send them. */
619  retVal = DPM_sendResult (gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle, true, &resultBuffer);
620  if (retVal < 0)
621  {
622  test_print ("Error: Failed to send results [Error: %d] to remote\n", retVal);
623  }
624  }
625  else
626  {
627  test_print ("Error: Failed to copy processing results to HSRAM, error=%d\n", retVal);
628  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
629  }
630  }
631  }
632  }
633 }

640 static void MmwDemo_clearEccAggrs(void)
641 {
642  uint8_t idx;
643 
644  /* Clear all status registers.*/
645  for(idx = 0; idx <= MMWDEMO_DSS_ECC_AGG_RAM_IDS_TOTAL_ENTRIES; idx++)
646  {
647  /* Write the RAM ID in to Vector register*/
648  CSL_REG32_FINS(MMWDEMO_DSS_ECC_AGG_ECC_VECTOR_ADDR, DSS_ECC_AGG_ECC_VECTOR_ECC_VECTOR, idx);
649  /* Clear pending interrupts.*/
650  CSL_REG32_WR(MMWDEMO_DSS_ECC_AGG_ERROR_STATUS1_ADDR, 0xF00);
651 
652  HW_WR_REG32((CSL_DSS_ECC_AGG_U_BASE + CSL_DSS_ECC_AGG_CONTROL), 0x7);
653  ClockP_usleep(100);
654  }
655 }

672  /* Check if error address falls in affected memory banks
673  DSS_L3 Bank 0
674  DSS_L3 Bank 1
675  DSS_L3 Bank 2

679  if ((ptrDssEccAggregs->SEC_STATUS_REG0 | 0x1F) != 0U)

683  * Treat this error as critical as per Errata
684  */
685  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
686  }

699 static void MmwDemo_dssInitTask(void* args)
700 {
701  int32_t errCode;
702  DPM_InitCfg dpmInitCfg;
703  DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams objDetInitParams;
704  uint32_t edmaCCIdx;
705 
706  CycleCounterP_reset();
707  /*****************************************************************************
708  * Driver Open/Configuraiton:
709  *****************************************************************************/
710 
711  /* Initialize the Data Path: */
712  MmwDemo_dataPathOpen(&gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj);
713 
714  /* Clear all status registers of DSS AGGR */
715  MmwDemo_clearEccAggrs();
716 
717  /* Enable interrupts (DSS L3 banks and DSS Mailbox memories) */
718  HW_WR_REG32((CSL_DSS_ECC_AGG_U_BASE + CSL_DSS_ECC_AGG_SEC_ENABLE_SET_REG0), 0x1F);
719 
720  /* Create binary semaphore to pend Main task, */
721  SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gMmwDssMCB.demoInitTaskCompleteSemHandle, 0);
722 
723  /*****************************************************************************
724  * Initialization of the DPM Module:
725  *****************************************************************************/
726  memset ((void *)&objDetInitParams, 0, sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams));
727 
728  /* Note this must be after MmwDemo_dataPathOpen() above which opens the hwa */
729  objDetInitParams.hwaHandle = gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj.hwaHandle;
730  objDetInitParams.L3ramCfg.addr = (void *)&gMmwL3[0];
731  objDetInitParams.L3ramCfg.size = sizeof(gMmwL3);
732 #ifndef MMWDEMO_TDM
733  objDetInitParams.L3ramCfg.endSize = sizeof(gMmwL3);
734 #endif
735  objDetInitParams.CoreLocalRamCfg.addr = &gDPC_ObjDetL2Heap[0];
736  objDetInitParams.CoreLocalRamCfg.size = sizeof(gDPC_ObjDetL2Heap);
737  for (edmaCCIdx = 0; edmaCCIdx < EDMA_NUM_CC; edmaCCIdx++)
738  {
739  objDetInitParams.edmaHandle[edmaCCIdx] = gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj.edmaHandle[edmaCCIdx];
740  }
741 
742  /* DPC Call-back config */
743  objDetInitParams.processCallBackCfg.processFrameBeginCallBackFxn =
744  MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_processFrameBeginCallBackFxn;
745  objDetInitParams.processCallBackCfg.processInterFrameBeginCallBackFxn =
746  MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_processInterFrameBeginCallBackFxn;
747 
748  memset ((void *)&dpmInitCfg, 0, sizeof(DPM_InitCfg));
749 
750  /* Setup the configuration: */
751  dpmInitCfg.ptrProcChainCfg = &gDPC_ObjectDetectionCfg;
752  dpmInitCfg.instanceId = 0xFEEDFEED;
753  dpmInitCfg.domain = DPM_Domain_REMOTE;
754  dpmInitCfg.reportFxn = MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_reportFxn;
755  dpmInitCfg.arg = &objDetInitParams;
756  dpmInitCfg.argSize = sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams);
757 
758  /* Initialize the DPM Module: */
759  gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle = DPM_init (&dpmInitCfg, &errCode);
760  if (gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle == NULL)
761  {
762  test_print ("Error: Unable to initialize the DPM Module [Error: %d]\n", errCode);
763  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
764  return;
765  }
766 
767  /* Synchronization: This will synchronize the execution of the control module
768  * between the domains. This is a prerequiste and always needs to be invoked. */
769  while (1)
770  {
771  int32_t syncStatus;
772 
773  /* Get the synchronization status: */
774  syncStatus = DPM_synch (gMmwDssMCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle, &errCode);
775  if (syncStatus < 0)
776  {
777  /* Error: Unable to synchronize the framework */
778  test_print ("Error: DPM Synchronization failed [Error code %d]\n", errCode);
779  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
780  return;
781  }
782  if (syncStatus == 1)
783  {
784  /* Synchronization acheived: */
785  break;
786  }
787  /* Sleep and poll again: */
788  ClockP_usleep(1 * 1000U);
789  }
790  test_print ("Debug: DPM Module Sync is done\n");
791 
792  /* Launch the DPM Task */
